planets.name: WASP-91 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-91 with a 2.8-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: WASP-91 b was found in 2017 by SuperWASP-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-91. Its orbit and size follow Anderson et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
